rci1_using_msad.detail: NIHPD normative reference data are multi-site.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "As normative reference data for brain growth, we used the multi-site longitudinal data from Objective 1 (i.e. initial time-point for enrolment from 4.5 to 18.5 years) of the publicly available NIHPD project (Evans and Brain Development Cooperative, 2006)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Normative reference data are from the NIHPD project only (not in the EPD list).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "As normative reference data for brain growth, we used the multi-site longitudinal data from Objective 1 (i.e. initial time-point for enrolment from 4.5 to 18.5 years) of the publicly available NIHPD project (Evans and Brain Development Cooperative, 2006)."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase normative cohort; 339 children scanned longitudinally for a total of 874 scans.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The normative model (Aubert-Broche et al., 2011) used data from 339 children (179 females and 160 males), scanned longitudinally at 2 or 3 time points, with approximately 24 months between scans and mean age at first scan of 11.0 years, for a total of 874 scans."
